scientific_integrity: The beta distribution follows from an explicit Gaussian conditional calculation; the limit and leading constant follow from a convolution proof. The companion numerical program checks, but does not establish, generality. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact instantaneous normal-forcing projection law for a real rank-one matrix and two independent unconditioned Gaussian sketches; not a global trajectory, structured-sketch, correlated-sketch, conditional-embedding, or finite-precision theorem. Historical-priority uncertainty remains.
title: Exact beta-product leakage and logarithmic tails in Gaussian oblique tangent projection
